Setup: Cesa seated, plain wall or grass, camera at her eye level not above
Direction: Hold 12 seconds. Do not call her name. Let her look away and back. The look away is the shot.
CesaOutfit: Halloween: witch hat or pumpkin sweater

Setup: Same seat, second Halloween outfit
Direction: Get 1 frame where she is looking directly down the lens. That frame is the thumbnail.
Reusable: Halloween, and any 'she is unbothered' turn

Setup: Warm indoor light, blanket or chair
Direction: Hold 12 seconds. Let her settle rather than posing her.

Setup: Kitchen or table edge, daylight
Direction: She does not need to look at the camera. Warm and domestic beats posed.

Setup: Soft indoor light, pale background
Direction: Hold longer than feels right. 15 seconds.

Setup: Evening lamp light, dark background
Direction: Low light on purpose. This lane is the only one that should look like night.
Props: string lights out of focus behind
CesaOutfit: New Year: sparkle collar or bow
Reusable: New Year and NYE, both ends of the calendar

Setup: Outdoors if the light is good, grass
Direction: Spring lane. Brighter and flatter than the rest on purpose.

Setup: No outfit. Cesa exactly as she is, asleep or settled
Direction: This is the most important shot of the day. No costume, no prompt. Just her, held for 30 seconds.
CesaOutfit: none, and that is the point
Reusable: the anchor shot for the whole account

Setup: Sit down, plain wall, phone at eye height, window light on your face
Direction: Anna Jarvis destroyed herself over the holiday she invented. Say it flat. No wry face.

Setup: Same setup, no reset
Direction: 36 years of letters, 5 presidents said no. Deliver the number and stop talking.

Setup: Same setup
Direction: The poisoned candy panic has no case behind it. Land on 'and it changed how a whole country parents'.
Reusable: Halloween, and any 'we believed it anyway' turn

Setup: Same setup
Direction: The men it was for asked it to stop for 58 years. Dry, not mocking.

Setup: Same setup
Direction: They gave up a day's pay to march for the day off. Let that sit before the turn.
Reusable: Labor Day, and any 'somebody paid for this' turn

Setup: Same setup, but say this one to the lens like a person not a script
Direction: Coming home after a shift. What she does. What it costs. This is the 7,726 view register and it is the only one proven on your own account.
Reusable: the highest value clip of the weekend

Setup: Same setup
Direction: 5 silent reactions, 4 seconds each: unimpressed, tired, quietly amused, caught out, done talking. No words.
Reusable: cutaway inserts for any reel, forever

Setup: A turnip and a pumpkin on a counter, daylight
Direction: Slow pan across both. The whole fact is that one replaced the other.

Setup: A candle burning, dark room, close
Direction: Hold 20 seconds unmoving. Atmosphere plate for any spooky fact.
Reusable: every Halloween typography reel that wants a plate

Setup: String lights out of focus, dark
Direction: Rack focus once, slowly, and stop.

Setup: An empty set table, no food, morning light
Direction: Slow push in. The emptiness is the point for a fact about a menu invented later.

Setup: Hands counting cash, or a receipt on a counter
Direction: Tight, unglamorous, no face. Black Friday was a complaint before it was a sale.
Reusable: Black Friday, and any money fact

Setup: A clock face, or a window at dusk
Direction: Hold 20 seconds. Do not move the camera.

Setup: Your hands doing something ordinary. Making coffee, folding, closing a door
Direction: 3 clips, 15 seconds each. These become the plate under any confessional line.
